svg.text: Generating text with the latent cache
the prompt runs once; after that, one token per step
prefill: the whole prompt in one pass
after "…came in off the" · real model output
Each step adds 9 squares (144 numbers) per layer to the cache and reads everything already there.
The cache holds 256 positions; sample.py keeps writing past that by re-prompting with the last 128 tokens.
Without the cache, step 3 would re-run all 7 tokens; with it, step 3 runs one token against 7 cached rows.
